title: Throughput Multiplier — First Real Calculation (Projected → Observed)
depends_on: S353 Boards A, B, C, D

pre_flight_gating.observed: Qualitative elimination (stale manifest caught, 0 defective items certified). Cannot be expressed as a simple multiplier — the gain is from prevention, not acceleration.
pre_flight_gating.delta: PROVEN — the first real defect prevention occurred. 351 false positives intercepted before planning.

delta_review.observed: N/A — first certification wave. All 77 items were Unprocessed (no prior certification to delta-compare against). This gain requires a second certification wave.
delta_review.status: STILL PROJECTED — no data yet. First measurable at S811→S812.

board_consolidation.observed: N/A — certification still operates in v1 board model. S853 used a batch script, not board model. v2 5-board model is designed but not yet adopted by active certification sessions.
board_consolidation.status: STILL PROJECTED — design complete, not yet adopted.

sessions_wave_reduction.note: Governance sessions (S852 manifest + S854 verification) are now separate from certification but included in total wave footprint

compound_realized.note: For the full certification + governance + verification cycle. Pure certification throughput (S853 only): 1.83×.
compound_realized.comparison_to_p1: 2.43× EXCEEDS S350 P1 target (1.5-2.0×). P1 threshold is met.
compound_realized.comparison_to_p3: 2.43× vs 3.8× — gap of 1.56×. The delta review component (2.0-2.5×, unrealized) would close this gap in subsequent waves.

what_is_real: Structural elimination of agent-per-item overhead is measured
what_is_still_projected: Delta review (2.0-2.5×) — requires second certification wave (S811+)
Board consolidation (1.3-1.4×) — requires adoption of v2 5-board model in certification sessions
P3 target (3.8×) — requires both delta review and board consolidation active on a multi-wave pipeline
honest_assessment.trajectory: P1 target (1.5-2.0×) is MET at 2.43×. P3 target (3.8×) is architecturally achievable at 1.83 × 2.0 × 1.3 = 4.76× but requires 2 components not yet exercised in this wave.

verdict: THROUGHPUT_MULTIPLIER_PARTIALLY_MEASURED — The realized multiplier (2.43× effective) exceeds the S350 P1 target and is based on observed data, not projections. This is the first real throughput measurement — S352 had 0% measured. The P3 target (3.8×) requires delta review (2.0-2.5×) which is inherently not exercisable in a first certification wave. The architecture supports the full multiplier; the data to prove it must come from S811+.
